key_insight: Momentum speeds up training in river-valley loss landscapes mainly by stabilizing larger learning rates, which lets optimization make faster progress along the low-loss river.
engineering_relevance: For large-scale model training, momentum can improve throughput and convergence by enabling aggressive learning rates without drifting far from the loss manifold.
method: Theoretical analysis of momentum dynamics on river-valley loss landscapes.
Characterize how momentum suppresses oscillations orthogonal to the river.
Compare acceleration sources: stabilization of learning rate vs. direct tracking speed gains.
evidence_signal: The paper is a theory-driven analysis grounded in the abstract's river-valley optimization model, rather than in new benchmark experiments.
watch_item: The claimed benefit may depend on the landscape being sufficiently river-valley-like; in very flat and slow-spinning rivers, momentum itself may add little beyond allowing a larger learning rate.
paper_title: Towards Understanding Momentum Acceleration in River-Valley Loss Landscape
